explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM (GPT-4o) and human (professional counselors) evaluations are conducted, but they assess different sets of instances (human evaluation for response generation quality, LLM evaluation for simulated dialogues in Japanese setting) and different criteria without any direct comparison or validation metrics reported.

prompts.notes: Prompt for dialogue evaluation (Comprehensiveness, Professionalism, Authenticity, Safety) adapted from prior work; prompt for topic prediction shown in Appendix B with Japanese and English versions.

guidelines.notes: Human evaluation used pairwise comparison (Win/Lose/Tie) with majority voting for suitability; examples of model responses shown in Appendix F, but detailed scoring rubric not provided.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluated dialogues on four predefined dimensions, while human evaluators assessed response suitability via pairwise comparison—no overlapping criteria were evaluated by both methods.
